questions.prompt: One sentence: What does the Skill do?
questions.answer: ProjectReady NAS checks an owner-selected project delivery folder for missing required files, ambiguous version candidates, and unresolved verification gaps, then reports a read-only readiness verdict.

questions.prompt: Who is the target user and problem?
questions.answer: Freelancers, small teams, and creators frequently hand off NAS-hosted projects with scattered revisions, incomplete deliverables, and unclear approval status. Manual review is repetitive and errors can delay delivery.

An evidence-first checklist review that distinguishes PRESENT, MISSING, and NOT_CHECKED, flags version conflicts for human approval, and refuses to label a delivery READY when evidence or permissions are insufficient.

questions.prompt: What is the Core User Flow?
questions.answer: The owner chooses one authorized folder and specifies mandatory deliverables. The Skill checks permitted file listings, identifies possible missing items and competing versions, optionally reviews individually approved documents, and returns a traceable READY, BLOCKED, or NEEDS_REVIEW report.

questions.prompt: What substantive difference does your idea offer compared with existing tools or conventional AI solutions?
questions.answer: Unlike generic chat summaries or filename-based cleanup utilities, the workflow treats incomplete scans as uncertainty rather than absence, avoids guessing the final version, and requires explicit evidence before declaring a project ready.

questions.prompt: Which UGREEN AI NAS capabilities will be used, and at which step in the workflow?
questions.answer: Planned file-agent ug-filesystem ls, find, and stat actions support owner-scoped discovery; separately authorized document-agent metadata, qa, or extract actions may support document inspection. These names are verified in the public catalog, not on a live NAS.

questions.prompt: What was your technical approach? Describe the planned Skill workflow, supported NAS CLI capabilities, expert agent orchestration, required inputs, permissions, AI model choices, and data handling, as applicable;
questions.answer: A Markdown Uliya Skill coordinates a folder-scoped file review, an optional explicitly approved document check, deterministic evidence classification, and a fail-closed verdict. Inputs are the folder, checklist, and review consent. Runtime Agent registration, effective permissions, invocation syntax, and model data flow require official verification; no external service is deliberately configured.

questions.prompt: What is the current development status? Identify what was implemented already, not yet implemented, or is pending NAS validation if selected to be a Finalist.
questions.answer: An original Skill draft, linked Markdown references, offline missing-file and version-review logic, policy safeguards, combined reporting, synthetic test scenarios, and package preflight are implemented. No official Uliya validator, installed-Agent call, NAS execution, or real privacy audit has been completed.

questions.prompt: What is your final validation plan? Name two core test cases and one edge case to validate if selected as a Finalist.
questions.answer: Core case 1: all required files present with complete authorized listing and attributable evidence. Core case 2: one genuinely missing required file and two ambiguous final-version candidates. Edge case: access denied or truncated listing must yield NOT_CHECKED, never a false READY.

questions.prompt: Are there any known limitations of your Project? Describe current known limitations, technical risks, and any external dependencies.
questions.answer: Official runtime support, Agent permissions, result completeness, content processing location, and SDK licensing remain unverified. A name match cannot prove version authority or confidentiality. The Skill never mutates files; uncertain results require human review.

disclosures.ai_assistance: OpenAI ChatGPT assisted drafting, skill design, offline prototype code, unit tests and review; human entrant controls the project and submission.
disclosures.platform: UGREEN Uliya/UGOS public official Starter Kit and file/document expert agent catalog (referenced, not bundled); official SDK license and runtime not verified.
disclosures.other_libraries: No external executable library or proprietary SDK files included inside proposed Markdown Skill ZIP. Offline prototyping uses Python standard library; no Python runtime included in Skill.
disclosures.data_flow: No customer NAS data has been accessed. Future owner-scoped NAS reading requires installed Agent, permission, and local/cloud processing verification.
